title: Quickmark
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -7 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original 128-second stereo melodic drum and bass instrumental at a fixed 174 BPM in 4/4. Start immediately with a loud, fully arranged chorus: punchy two-step breakbeat, kick, snare, hats, rounded bass, bright synth chords and a clipped four-note lead hook. Keep all parts active from the first beat to the final beat. Clear per-beat melodic attacks and steady dancefloor loudness in every 8-second section. Vary the lead and chords after one minute but never remove the drums, bass or melody. Energetic playful rhythm-game music for all ages. No intro, breakdown, quiet bridge, build, outro, fade, silence, vocals, speech, samples, copying or tempo drift.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: four sharply cut check marks leap across a staggered rhythm grid, cyan and ivory with one coral marker. No check box, score UI, text or character.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Horizontal duohertz title card with staggered rhythm grid and quick marks on right, title Quickmark on left, sparse halftone and dark print styling.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
art_provenance.cover_svg: Local SVG title overlay around the authored cover-art.png
